institution: IIIT Guwahati (Indian Institute of Information Technology, Guwahati)
data_source: Careers360 student reviews and Q&A (aggregated public review data)

key_positive_themes.notes: Well-furnished AC classrooms and labs, clean and silent library, big campus with sports areas; hostels equipped with gym, pool table, table tennis, foosball, air hockey, and music rooms.
Around 85-90% placement rate reported in ECE; highest package around 16 LPA; top recruiters include Samsung and L&T; ~70% internship conversion.
Teachers described as helpful, well-qualified, and supportive in gaining industry experience; curriculum kept updated with latest trends.
Highest-rated categories (4.0/5 each); scenic, green campus contributes positively to overall experience.

key_negative_themes.notes: Recurring complaint that mess food needs to be made healthier and updated.
Campus situated far from the city, which some students note as a drawback.
Library described as a little small, attributed to the institute being relatively new (established 2013); expected to improve over time.
Wide gap between highest (16 LPA) and lowest (4 LPA) packages indicates inconsistent placement outcomes across branches/students.

sample_reviews_analyzed.review_snippet: Mess food should be made healthy and updated — well-furnished AC classrooms and labs, clean library, but food not good
Almost 90% of students were placed in ECE, highest package 16 LPA, lowest 4 LPA, top recruiters Samsung and L&T
Every hostel has gym, pool table, table tennis, carrom, foosball, air hockey, music room, library, sports grounds
Library is a little small being a new institute but it is definitely going to improve
College fees per semester is Rs 112500 excluding mess and hostel charges

conclusion: Sentiment toward IIIT Guwahati is positive and fairly balanced across categories, with particular strength in value for money and campus life. As a relatively young institute (established 2013), it shows some growing pains — a still-developing library and food quality concerns — but strong hostel amenities, decent placement rates, and supportive faculty keep overall sentiment favorable.
disclaimer: This analysis is based on a sample of publicly available student reviews and Q&A threads (Careers360) as of the search date and is illustrative, not a scientifically exhaustive sentiment study. Care was taken to source data specifically for IIIT Guwahati, distinct from the separate institute IIT Guwahati.
